text: This application proposes to demolish the existing two-storey mixed-use buildings, which collectively contain 12 rental dwelling units, to permit the redevelopment of the lands with a 27-storey apartment building comprised of 354 dwelling units, including 12 affordable replacement rental units and 14 new affordable rental units. As of the date of this report, the total Gross Floor Area (GFA) of the proposed development would be 23,987 square metres, including 663 square metres of non-residential GFA, resulting in a Floor Space Index (FSI) of 9.73 times the site area. The properties are also the subject of a Zoning By-law Amendment (ZBA) application (19 263422 STE 04 OZ), which was appealed to the Ontario Land Tribunal (OLT), formerly the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal (LPAT), in June 2020 (Case No. PL200248) on the basis of City Council's failure to make a decision on the application…
